get.summary: Fetch rebooking statistics grouped by original dated service journey
get.description: Fetch statistics for original departures from today onward in Norwegian local time. Supply exactly one of organisationId or lineId; supplying both or neither returns 400. The caller must have reservation read access to the organisations owning the selected original and replacement departures. Statistics count travel intentions, not individual reservation legs, under the original departure. Departures whose five rebooking counters are all zero are omitted. The reservation status defaults to DRAFT; rebooking statuses are MANUAL, SUGGESTED and ACCEPTED, in that priority order. Snoozed travel intentions are counted separately and excluded from active counts. No-journey travel intentions are counted separately for DRAFT only.

parameters.name: organisationId
parameters.description: Owner organisation of the original departures. Required when lineId is omitted; cannot be combined with lineId.

parameters.name: lineId
parameters.description: Line of the original departures. Required when organisationId is omitted; cannot be combined with organisationId.

parameters.name: reservationStatus
parameters.description: The status of the reservations considered, defaults to DRAFT

200.description: Rebooking statistics for the original departures.

400.description: Supply exactly one of organisationId or a non-blank lineId.

403.description: The caller lacks read access to the requested data.

get.summary: Fetch grouped reservations for a travel intention
get.description:
Fetches all travel intentions connected to the given original dated service journey id, grouped by travel intention reference with their full rebooking history. 
            Each group contains all versions of the travel intention and the reservations belonging to each version. Filters on reservation status and rebooking status are 
            applied only to the latest version of each travel intention — groups where the latest version does not match are excluded entirely. The fullHistory parameter 
            controls how many versions are included per group: when true (default), all versions are returned; when false, only the two most recent versions are returned.

parameters.name: originalDatedServiceJourneyId
parameters.description: The ID of the original dated service journey — the departure the travel intentions were initially created for and that connects all related travel intentions and their reservations together.

parameters.name: reservationStatus
parameters.description: The `reservation status` to filter on. If not specified, all statuses are included.

parameters.name: rebookingStatusFilter
parameters.description: The `rebooking statuses` to filter on. Defaults to all statuses if not specified.

parameters.name: fullHistory
parameters.description: Whether to return the full version history of each travel intention. If false, only the two most recent versions are returned. Defaults to full history.

parameters.name: reservationLineReference
parameters.description: The `reference` of the reservation line that will be fetched

Entur Client Header.
It is required that all consumers identify themselves by using this header.
Entur will deploy strict rate-limiting policies on API-consumers who do not identify with a header and reserves the right to block unidentified consumers.
The structure of ET-Client-Name should be: `<company>-<application>`.
